subject.title: docs: LiteLLM supply chain attack advisory (v1.82.7 / v1.82.8)

question: What LiteLLM install and remediation guidance should OpenClaw publish for new proxy installs and for operators who ran 1.82.7 or 1.82.8?
rationale: The docs fix is small, but the version pin is a security guidance decision that can become stale or send new users to an old fallback release.

options.title: Separate install and rollback guidance
options.body: Keep the general quick start aligned with maintainer-approved current safe install guidance, and reserve 1.82.6 only for explicit affected-version rollback if desired.

options.title: Pin all installs to 1.82.6
options.body: Use the issue's conservative pin everywhere, accepting that new users may be directed to an older incident fallback version.

options.title: Advisory-only wording
options.body: Warn about 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 with rotation/audit steps but defer version choice to upstream LiteLLM docs.

recommendation.title: Separate install and rollback guidance
recommendation.body: Keep the general quick start aligned with maintainer-approved current safe install guidance, and reserve 1.82.6 only for explicit affected-version rollback if desired.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a security-sensitive docs direction choice, and this handle appears in adjacent provider/docs history plus repository ownership routing.
